item.title: tidain/YunX-Desktop
item.description:
YunX（云析）的官方 windows 桌面端

云析桌面版 · YunX-Desktop

粘贴分享链接，直接高速下载 —— 云析 YunX 官方 Windows 桌面版

网盘：夸克 / UC / 迅雷 / 百度 / 139 / 123 / 115 / 光鸭 / 蓝奏云 / 蓝奏云优享版； 视频：哔哩哔哩 / 小红书 / 抖音 / 微博 / 快手 / AcFun / Pixiv；另支持磁力 / BT 种子 / ed2k 等 P2P 链接。 Range 分片并发 + 断点续传，B 站高清自动合轨。

下载最新版 · 功能 · 使用 · 浏览器插件 · 构建 · 常见问题 · 与安卓版差异

云析永远免费开源。 如果你是在任何地方「花钱买到」的，说明你被骗了，请立即退款。 任何收费版本均为二次打包的诈骗版本，与本项目无关。

本项目使用 AGPL-3.0 开源协议。 与安卓版 CYQawa/YunX 同属云析项目；若你使用了本项目的代码，请同样以 AGPL-3.0 开放源代码。

简介

云析 YunX 的 官方 Windows 桌面版：粘贴网盘分享链接或视频作品链接，即可浏览内容、在线预览并直接高速下载，全程在电脑上完成； 也支持磁力 / BT 种子 / ed2k 等 P2P 链接下载。 网盘与视频平台都支持多账号（主账号 / 备注），登录凭证加密存本机，并可导出加密备份换机恢复。 提供免安装便携版（整个文件夹拷走即用）与安装版（开始菜单 / 桌面快捷方式，可卸载）两种分发形式。

截图
主界面 网盘登录
设置 关于

支持平台

  • 夸克网盘

  • UC 网盘

  • 迅雷网盘

  • 百度网盘

  • 139 网盘（和彩云）

  • 123 云盘

  • 115 网盘

  • 光鸭云盘

  • 蓝奏云 / 蓝奏云优享版

  • GitHub（仓库 / 账号 / 文件直链）

  • 视频解析：抖音 / 快手 / 微博 / 小红书 / 哔哩哔哩 / AcFun / Pixiv

  • 磁力 / BT 种子 / ed2k（P2P 下载，可导入本地种子文件）

Warning

不建议使用百度网盘，可能导致账号被风控！

浏览器插件

仓库 browser-extension/ 内含 Chrome / Edge 扩展「云析下载助手」（Manifest V3）—— 让浏览器下载接管到云析的多线程下载。

  • 嗅探页面资源：列出当前网页里可下载的媒体与文件，按图片 / 视频 / 音频 / 文档 / 压缩包 / 程序 / 字体分类，图片与视频支持卡片预览。
  • 接管浏览器下载：浏览器开始下载时自动接管（取消浏览器下载并抹掉记录），由云析弹窗询问保存目录与线程数（最高 512，超过 32 需二次确认）。
  • 归还浏览器下载：点「归还浏览器下载」后重新发起浏览器原生下载，并对该页面网站（根域名及其子域名）写入 5 分钟冷却；冷却期内打开插件可看到「还有 X 分 YY 秒」倒计时，并可点「立即重新开始」单独解除当前网站的冷却。
  • 视频平台卡片：B 站视频页可选清晰度与下载方式；抖音 / 微博 / AcFun 视频页可一键交给云析解析下载。
  • 安全：扩展与云析通过本机回环 HTTP（127.0.0.1，随机 token）通信，网页脚本无法伪造请求；云析没运行时探测不到端口，扩展完全不干预浏览器下载。

安装、开关与工作原理见 浏览器插件说明。

功能

  • 分享链接解析 —— 识别夸克 / UC / 迅雷 / 百度 / 139 / 123 / 115 / 光鸭 / 蓝奏云 / 蓝奏云优享版 分享链接并自动匹配提取码，另支持 GitHub 仓库 / 账号 / 文件直链

  • 视频解析与预览 —— 粘贴抖音 / 快手 / 微博 / 小红书 / B站 / AcFun / Pixiv 作品链接（短链、口令、整段文案均可）即可解析；在线预览优先用 ffplay 直读直链（真·边下边播，HLS 原生支持），本机没装 FFmpeg 时回退内置播放器并可一键下载引擎到应用私有目录（不改系统环境变量）；图集可放大查看，下载支持 DASH 合轨（优先 ffmpeg -c copy）与 Live Photo 动图合成（可存动态照片 / 静图 / 视频）

  • 高速下载 —— Range 分片并发 + 断点续传 + 慢连接自动换线 + 全局限速；B 站高清分轨两轨并行下载后自动合轨

  • P2P 下载 —— 磁力 / BT 种子 / ed2k 电驴链接交给 Gopeed 引擎下载；支持导入本地 .torrent 种子文件、BT Tracker 服务器二级页管理与 DHT 开关，下载中可查看「种子 / 连接 / 节点」概览

  • GitHub 浏览与 README 渲染 —— 浏览仓库文件树 / Releases / 账号仓库列表，README 与更新说明以 GFM Markdown 渲染

  • GitHub 下载镜像自动测速 —— 内置五个 gh-proxy 系镜像，下载前并发实测每个镜像的延迟与下载速度，按速度自动选最快（设置页可看 ping / 速度、手动刷新、固定某个或自定义前缀），更新包 / 视频引擎 / Gopeed 内核 / README 图片统一走该镜像

  • 通知中心进度 —— 下载进度实时显示为 Windows 通知中心 toast 进度条（多任务聚合 + 实时速度）

  • 多种登录方式 —— 内嵌 Chromium 登录 / 一键导入本机浏览器 Cookie / 手动粘贴 Cookie；GitHub 可选 Personal Access Token

  • Windows 系统集成 —— 原生托盘菜单（亮暗跟随系统配色）、原生文件对话框、剪贴板分享链接检测

  • 多账号与认证备份 —— 网盘与视频平台都支持多账号（主账号 / 备注 / 逐个退出）；「设置 → 认证备份」可加密导出 / 导入全部账号，换机免重登

  • 桌面体验 —— 深色模式 + 自定义种子色、链接收藏、解析历史、窗口内弹窗覆盖层

  • 网络 —— GitHub 下载镜像（自动测速选最快 / 固定预选 / 自定义前缀）、HTTP 代理（便于加速或直连受限的场景）

  • 引擎管理 —— 下载引擎（Gopeed 内核）与视频预览引擎（FFmpeg 精简版）集中管理，可下载 / 更新 / 卸载并查看路径与来源

完整功能清单见 功能清单。

与安卓版的差异

桌面版在登录方式、系统集成（托盘 / 通知 / 原生对话框）、数据存储、构建分发上针对 Windows 做了适配， 并移除了移动端专属功能。完整清单见 与安卓版的差异。

技术栈

分类 选型
语言 Kotlin
UI Compose Multiplatform（Desktop）+ Material 3
持久化 sqlite-jdbc（SQLite）+ java.util.prefs
网络 OkHttp 4.12.0（请求 + 分片下载）
内嵌浏览器 JCEF 132（Chromium）
视频预览 ffplay（FFmpeg 套件，边下边播）+ JavaFX Media（兜底）
原生桥接 JNA（Win32 API）+ 自编 darkmode.dll
构建分发 Gradle + jlink + jpackage + Inno Setup
Markdown 渲染 multiplatform-markdown-renderer（GFM：README / 更新说明）

使用

  1. 在「网盘」页登录需要使用的网盘账号（推荐内嵌浏览器登录）；视频解析平台的登录在「解析」页对应平台卡片或结果页里完成
  2. 在「解析」页粘贴分享链接或视频链接（可带提取码，支持从剪贴板一键粘贴）
  3. 网盘分享会进入文件浏览页，视频链接会进入结果页（可选清晰度 / 图集 / 预览）
  4. 在「下载」页查看进度，支持暂停 / 继续 / 删除 / 打开；进度同步显示在 Windows 通知中心

设置项、数据目录、托盘操作见 使用说明。

构建

要求：Windows 10/11 x64，另需一个 C++ 编译器（托盘菜单配色桥接层用；缺它时 run / package / installer 会在这一步失败）。JDK、Gradle、Inno Setup 均无需手动安装。

git clone https://github.com/tidain/YunX-Desktop.git
cd YunX-Desktop

.\run.ps1 run        # 编译并启动（开发，含 darkmode.dll）
.\run.ps1 build      # 仅编译 Kotlin（不需要 C++ 编译器）
.\run.ps1 package    # 免安装便携版 → release\YunX-Desktop\
.\run.ps1 installer  # 单文件安装程序 → release\YunX-Desktop-setup-*.exe

环境要求、版本号管理与打包产物见 构建与打包。

常见问题

为什么从「第三方移植」变成了「官方桌面版」？

项目早期确实是社区移植（安卓版 CYQawa/YunX 的 Windows 移植）。 2026 年 10 月 2 日上午 8:40，桌面版作者（tidain）加入安卓版仓库成为协作者， 桌面版自此与安卓版同属一个项目，作为云析的官方 Windows 桌面端维护； 两端的代码、发布节奏与分发方式仍各自独立。

百度网盘下载 / 转存不了？

账号被风控了，详见安卓版 issue #9。

便携版和安装版有什么区别？

便携版是免安装的文件夹，拷到任意位置双击 YunX-Desktop.exe 即可运行； 安装版走安装向导，安装到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\YunX-Desktop，并创建开始菜单 / 桌面快捷方式，可在设置中卸载。 两者功能完全一致。

下载时看不到 Windows 通知中心的通知？

先确认「设置 → 系统 → 通知」已开启（专注助手 / 免打扰也会拦通知）。应用在检测到通知未送达时， 会尝试自动创建所需的开始菜单快捷方式兜底，但最终能否弹出仍取决于系统通知设置。

item.description:
A cross-platform music app using YouTube Music for backend

https://simpmusic.org/

SimpMusic

A FOSS YouTube Music client for Android and Desktop with many features from
Spotify, SponsorBlock, ReturnYouTubeDislike using Compose Multiplatform to develop.






Download


On vivo phones, install SimpMusic-full-vivo-*.apk from Releases for Origin Island and the music widget. It installs as a separate app and can't sit next to Spotify.

Nightly Build




kotlin-footguns — the Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform and desktop JVM traps this project ran into the hard way. Star it if it saves you a night.

Features ✨️

  • Play music from YouTube Music or YouTube for free, without ads and in the background
  • Library sync between your phone and your computer: likes, followed artists, saved albums and podcasts, playlists and listening history (NEW)
  • Radio builder: pick artists, songs and genres and tune one radio from all of them, plus a daily Replay Mix of the songs you play most (NEW)
  • 8D audio that moves the song around your head (NEW)
  • Delete lyrics, and an animated lyrics background that pulses to the beat (NEW)
  • Choose the app icon (Android), full screen on Desktop, search in Settings and a switch to stop long titles scrolling (NEW)
  • Import your YouTube and Spotify sign-ins from a browser on Desktop (NEW)
  • Recognize the song playing near you, then find it in SimpMusic (Android)
  • Add your own synced lyrics, line by line or word by word, to songs that have none
  • Read YouTube comments in Now Playing, and post, reply or like them when signed in
  • Your library sidebar on Desktop with your playlists, albums, artists and podcasts
  • Four Now Playing styles: Classic, Material 3 Expressive, a redesigned Apple Music player with Apple Music-style lyrics, and SoundCloud (NEW)
  • Ten-band equalizer with presets and AutoEq headphone profiles, plus Delay and Reverb effects, or your phone's system equalizer on Android
  • Pick the speaker, headphones or Cast device SimpMusic plays on, without moving other apps' audio
  • SimpMusic Wrapped: your year in music, plus monthly recap playlists
  • On-device listening analytics: charts, period history, listening clock and a shareable listening receipt
  • Word-by-word Apple Music-style lyrics, romanization for 12 languages, share lyrics as an image, landscape fullscreen lyrics and a timing offset
  • Home screen widgets: turntable, playlists and listening insights
  • Send your sign-ins from Android to Desktop by scanning a QR code
  • Preferred audio language for videos with several audio tracks
  • High quality up-to 256kbps stream (Opus or AAC) for YouTube Music Premium users
  • Browsing Home, Charts, Podcast, Moods & Genre with YouTube Music data at high speed
  • Search everything on YouTube
  • Spotify Canvas and Animated Album Art supported
  • Power your experience with SimpMusic Chart (https://chart.simpmusic.org/)
  • Play 1080p video option with subtitle
  • Play YouTube Music live stations
  • AI song suggestions and an AI reading of your music taste
  • Import playlists converted from Spotify and other apps
  • Customize your playlist, synced with YouTube Music
  • Notifications from followed artists
  • Caching and offline playback support, plus Smart downloads of the songs you play most (Android)
  • Crossfade with DJ-style like Apple Music
  • Customizing THEME (Light, Dark, AMOLED, Color, presets from popular music apps, etc)
  • Synced lyrics from SimpMusic Lyrics, LRCLIB, BetterLyrics, Spotify (require login) and YouTube Transcript - AI lyrics translation (BETA) (*)
  • Personalize data (**) and multi-YouTube-account support
  • Dislike songs on YouTube Music so it recommends them less
  • Last.fm scrobbling (Full version)
  • Supports SponsorBlock and Return YouTube Dislike
  • Sleep Timer
  • Android Auto with online content, feature rich UI/UX
  • Discord Rich Presence support
  • Listen Together: shared rooms that play in sync with friends, compatible with Metrolist
  • And many more!

(*) Use your own API key from OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral AI, xAI, Together AI, Fireworks AI, Cerebras, Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible service
(**) For users who chose "Send back to Google" feature

Warning
This app is in the beta stage, so it may have many bugs and make it crash. If you find any bugs,
please create an issue or contact me via email or Discord server.
Because of depending on YouTube Music, the player error will happen and it's normally, please don't ask me about the stable state of this app.

Screenshots

More screenshots here.

Data

  • This app uses hidden API from YouTube Music with some tricks to get data from YouTube Music.
  • Use Spotify Web API and some tricks to get Spotify Canvas and Lyrics
  • Thanks to InnerTune for the idea to get data from YouTube Music. This repo is my inspiration to create this app.
  • Special thanks to SmartTube. This repo help me to extract the streaming URL of YouTube Music.
  • My app is using SponsorBlock to skip sponsor in YouTube videos.
  • ReturnYouTubeDislike for getting information on votes
  • Main lyrics data from SimpMusic Lyrics
  • Alternative lyrics data from LRCLIB. More information LRCLIB
  • Song recognition by Shazam, with the recognizer ported from Metrolist

Privacy

SimpMusic doesn't have any tracker or third-party server for collecting user data in FOSS version. If YouTube
logged-in users enable "Send back to Google" feature, SimpMusic only uses YouTube Music Tracking API to send listening history and listening record of video to Google for better recommendations and
supporting artist or YouTube Creator (For API reference,
see this).

We collect crash data in the Full version to improve the app.

Full or FOSS version

Every Android release comes in two builds, SimpMusic-full-*.apk and SimpMusic-foss-*.apk. The Desktop app is the Full build.

Full FOSS
Crash reports Sentry (open source) None
Google Cast Yes No (no Google Play Services)
Last.fm scrobbling Yes No
Discord Rich Presence Log in on Discord's own page Log in with your Discord account token

Last.fm and the Discord login need the app's own API keys, which only the official Full build carries. The FOSS build has no keys, no Google Play Services and no tracking. If you don't want crash data collected, use the FOSS version.

Desktop app

Which file should I download?

  • For Windows: Download SimpMusic-Windows-installer.zip, unzip it and run install.bat.
  • For macOS (macOS 15 or newer): Download the file with extension .dmg.
  • For Linux: Download the file with extension .AppImage (all Linux distributions)

Log in guide: https://www.simpmusic.org/blogs/en/how-to-log-in-on-desktop-app

Discord: log in from Settings on Discord's own page in your browser, no token needed

Some limitations on Desktop app:

  • Some Linux distributions may have stability issues (upstream JetBrains issue).
  • ARM64 on Windows and Linux: use the x64 build.

Please report issues on our Discord server if you find any bugs.

Translation


You can help me translate this app into your language by using Crowdin SimpMusic on Crowdin

Special thanks to all translators on Crowdin ❤️

FAQ

1. Wrong Lyrics?

Lyrics are provided by LRCLIB and other sources. Sometimes lyrics may not match perfectly with the YouTube videoId parameter. So I need to use some "String Matcher" and "Duration" to search lyrics. So sometimes, some songs or videos get the wrong lyrics.

2. Why the name or brand is "SimpMusic"?

Simply, because I love the name. It's a combination of 'Simple' and 'Music'. But SimpMusic is not a simple app, it's all you need for a powerful music streaming app.

More FAQ, join my Discord channel

Contributing

Contributions are welcome — the full guide lives in CONTRIBUTING.md. The short version:

  1. Start from an issue. Every PR needs an accepted issue behind it — open one first so the change is agreed before the code exists.
  2. Fork and branch from dev (main tracks releases), and fill in the whole PR template — one checkbox is machine-checked.
  3. AI policy. AI-assisted work is welcome; AI-driven work is not:
    • A human must have written or personally reviewed every line and be able to answer review comments about it.
    • Unattended agent submissions (Jules, Devin, and friends) are closed automatically by the triage bot, on sight.
    • Commits carrying AI co-author trailers (Co-Authored-By: Claude/Copilot/…) or "Generated with …" markers are rejected the same way — squash them out first.
    • Repeat offenders are blocked.
  4. Translations go through Crowdin, never PRs editing the string files directly.

See our CODE OF CONDUCT. Thanks for all my contributors:

Legal Disclaimer & Terms of Use

1. 100% Free, Open-Source & Strictly Non-Commercial

SimpMusic is a fully open-source project (FOSS) created purely for educational purposes and personal use. We do not sell this application, nor do we monetize it in any way. There are no advertisements, no premium features, no subscriptions, and no hidden fees within the app. This project has absolutely no commercial value or financial intent.

2. A Custom Browser with Content Filtering

SimpMusic acts strictly as a specialized, third-party web browser and client. It simply parses the publicly available website content and APIs of YouTube and YouTube Music, rendering them in a custom user interface. The ad-free experience it provides is fundamentally no different from using a standard web browser (like Chrome, Firefox, or Brave) equipped with a common ad-blocking extension (such as uBlock Origin).

3. Support Content Creators

We deeply respect the hard work of artists, musicians, and content creators. We strongly encourage all users to subscribe to YouTube Premium. Purchasing a Premium subscription is the best way to financially support the creators you listen to and ensure the continued growth of the platform. SimpMusic is built as a proof-of-concept for developers and enthusiasts, not to harm creators' revenues.

4. No Hosting of Copyrighted Material

We do not host, upload, distribute, or store any audio, video, or copyrighted media files on our own servers. All content accessed through this application is stored entirely on Google's/YouTube's servers and remains the property of their respective copyright owners. The app merely acts as a conduit to stream publicly accessible links.

5. User Responsibility & Legal Contact

The software is provided "AS IS", without warranty of any kind. The developers of SimpMusic do not encourage or condone piracy. Users are solely responsible for ensuring their usage of this app complies with their local copyright laws and the Terms of Service of the platforms they access.

Because we do not host any media files, we cannot process DMCA takedown requests for audio or video content. However, if you represent a copyright holder or have legal concerns regarding the open-source code itself, please contact us via email at: ndtminh2608@gmail.com

item.title: aistra0528/Hail
item.description:
Disable / Hide / Suspend / Uninstall Android apps without root.

English | 简体中文 | 日本語

Hail 雹

Hail is a free-as-in-freedom software to freeze Android apps. GitHub Releases

Freeze

Freeze is a word that describes the action of blocking (immediately stopping) apps when they are not needed/in-use ( on-demand request) which in turn helps the device to cut down on the usage of RAM and save power. Users can also unfreeze them to revert to their original state.

In general, "freeze" means disable, but also Hail can "freeze" apps by hiding and suspending them.

Disable

Disabled apps will not be shown in the launcher and will be shown as "Disabled" in the installed apps list. Enable them to revert the action.

Hide

Hidden apps will not be shown in the launcher and in the installed apps list. Unhide them to revert the action.

While in this state, which is almost like an uninstalled state, the package will be unavailable, however, the application data and the actual package file will not be removed from the device.

Suspend (Android 7.0+)

Suspended apps will have their icons shown in grayscale within the device's launcher. Unsuspend them to revert the action.

While in this state, the application's notifications will be hidden, any of its started activities will be stopped and it will not be able to show toasts, dialogs or even play audio. When the user tries to launch a suspended app, the system will, instead, show a dialog to the user informing them that they cannot use this app while it is suspended.

Suspend only prevents the user from interacting with the app, it does NOT prevent the app from running in the background.

Working mode

Any app that has been frozen on Hail will need to be unfrozen by the same working mode.

  1. For devices supporting wireless debugging (Android 11+) or rooted devices, Shizuku is recommended.

  2. For rooted devices, Root is an alternative. It is slower.

Device Owner

Set device owner by adb

Android Debug Bridge (adb) Guide

Download Android SDK Platform-Tools

adb shell dpm set-device-owner com.aistra.hail/.receiver.DeviceAdminReceiver

item.description:
Kernel-based Android Root Solution & KPM

https://SukiSU.org

SukiSU Nova

English 简体中文 |

A kernel-based root solution for Android, evolved from tiann/KernelSU with some interesting changes added.

Features

  1. Kernel-based su and permission management.
  2. App Profile: keep root access in a cage.
  3. KPM support.
  4. Built-in Zygisk (NyaZygisk) — no separate Zygisk module needed; running status is shown right on the home screen.
  5. Theme Store: browse, install and submit themes, with multi-source mirrors, author authorization and review.
  6. Kernel Extension Center: CPU/vvar spoofing, AVC log spoofing, version spoofing, SUSFS and mount view hiding — all in one place.
  7. Built-in SUSFS management tools with one-tap root hiding configuration.
  8. Dual UI: Miuix / Material 3 Expressive; supports Miuix splash screen, module banners and sorting, temporary root grant, and kernel-free preview.

Compatibility

  • SukiSU Nova supports GKI 2.0 devices (kernel version 5.10 and above).
  • Older kernels are also compatible (minimum 4.14+), but you need to compile the kernel yourself.
  • With additional backports, 3.x kernels (3.4–3.18) can be supported.
  • Currently supported architectures: arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a (bare), X86_64, riscv64.
  • Note: This project has evolved independently since forking from tiann/KernelSU; compatibility is based on testing in this repository and no longer equals the official KernelSU support scope.

Kernel Compatibility Status

Scenario Method Notes
GKI devices (kernel 5.10+) LKM mode recommended
Non-GKI / old kernels (3.0+) Compile the kernel manually Please refer to the integration guide on the website
KPM features required Requires CONFIG_KPM=y See "KPM Support" below

KPM Support

Developed based on KernelPatch, with features duplicating KernelSU removed — only KPM support is kept.

Current status:

  • ✅ Basic KPM loading is available (requires CONFIG_KPM=y)
  • 🚧 The APatch compatibility layer is still being completed (some features are not yet merged)
  • ⚠️ Non-GKI devices additionally require CONFIG_KALLSYMS=y and CONFIG_KALLSYMS_ALL=y
  • ⚠️ Kernels below 4.19 need set_memory.h backported from 4.19

Open-source repository: ShirkNeko/SukiSU_KernelPatch_patch
KPM template: udochina/KPM-Build-Anywhere

Troubleshooting

  1. KPM fails to load?
    Make sure the kernel has CONFIG_KPM=y enabled; Non-GKI devices also need CONFIG_KALLSYMS=y and CONFIG_KALLSYMS_ALL=y.

  2. The manager doesn't recognize root?
    Make sure the flashed kernel matches the manager version, and check whether su is in PATH.

  3. Kernel compilation errors?
    Refer to guide/how-to-integrate.md, and make sure the kernel version meets the minimum requirement (4.14+).

item.title: realidkroo/Mochy-Music
item.description:
A modern, cool, sleek music player. made with <3

https://mochy.fun/

What is Mochy Music? its a sleek modern cool music player for android, open source, packed with features and doesn’t collect ur data >_< !! oh and, still in beta! so please expect some bug 😃


Mochy Music: a free, open source music player for Android with style

Mochy is a modern music player for Android. It plays from YouTube Music and from modules, shows word by word lyrics, has a proper audio lab, imports your playlists from other apps, and can be re-skinned by anyone with a small zip file. No account needed, no ads, no tracking.

Warning

Mochy is still in beta, expect some bugs! Reporting them helps a lot.

📖 Full documentation: mochy.fun/wiki, with pictures. It covers the app page by page and everything about making modules.

Features

Area What you get
Player Nine styles (Flagship, Classic, Turntable, iPod, Poster, Timeline, Lyrics, Bedside, Video), animated canvas and music video covers, swipe to skip, hold the player to change its style.
Lyrics Word by word, asked from many sources at once and the best one kept (timed lyrics win). Switch source, nudge the timing, translate. Floating lyrics over other apps, widgets, and lyrics on the car screen.
Audio lab Equalizer, a mixer with buses, sends and effect chains, Liveprog scripts, loudness meter, 3D sims, crossfade, and a provider order that decides where each song comes from.
Library Local files, downloads, playlists, likes. Import from Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music and Tidal, every song is matched so it plays here.
Stats & recap Listening time, top songs, artists and genres, and a "wrapped" style recap whenever you want. All on your phone.
Everywhere Chromecast, Google TV and DLNA casting, Android Auto, a TV app, home screen widgets, "Hey Google, play … on Mochy".
Backup Dropbox or any WebDAV server, by hand or on a schedule. Your logins never go in a backup.
Modules Add songs, lyrics, song info, audio effects, looks, whole players, nav bars and glass with a zip. See Modules.
Privacy No account system, no server of ours, no analytics. GPL-3.0, read what it does.

Hhhh-how to install? :3

  1. On your phone, open the latest release.
  2. Download the .apk that matches your phone. If you are not sure, pick arm64, that is almost every phone from the last 8 years. The universal one works everywhere but is bigger.
  3. Open the downloaded file. Android will ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager, say yes (you can turn it off again after).
  4. Open Mochy. It walks you through a username, importing (you can skip it) and a blur check. No account needed to start listening.

Updating works the same way: install the new apk over the old one and your library stays. Mochy also tells you inside the app when there is a new one.

Build Use it when
arm64 Almost every phone. Pick this one.
Universal You are not sure, or you use an emulator. Bigger.
F-Droid flavor You want no self-update permission and no Play Services.

Tip

Only download Mochy from the releases page of this repo. A random mediafire or telegram link could be a modified app, and then your logins would not be safe, pls avoid those.

Note

Mochy officially supports Android 8.0 and newer. Android 7 works unofficially.

Update channels

Channel You get
Release Normal GitHub releases only.
Nightly Prereleases too (9.0.0.2 is the second nightly after 9.0.0), and the next release once it is newer than your nightly.

Pick it on the version card of the Profile page.

Some Prview

Where the code lives

Path What is in it
app The Android app: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, the player, playback service, library database, native audio engine.
modules/api The module contract (MochyModule.kt), plain Kotlin with no Android in it, so a module can be built on its own.
modules/bridge The JSON bridge that lets a module's own code run safely inside Mochy.
modules/applemusic, monochrome, jiosaavn Built in modules, written against :modules:api only.
providers/* Clients for the services Mochy talks to: InnerTube, LRCLIB, Better Lyrics, SimpMusic, Musixmatch, Genius, KuGou, Last.fm, Wikipedia, Shazam, canvas and artist video.
docs The website and the wiki, served by GitHub Pages. Longer notes on tricky parts are in docs/notes.
tools Profiling scripts and audio engine tests.

Modules

A module adds something to Mochy. One zip with a manifest.json can bring any of these:

What it adds Example
Songs A new audio source in the provider order.
Lyrics A lyrics provider that goes first while it is on.
Song info Facts and credits for the About song sheet.
Audio effects Effects for the mixer.
Looks Colours, fonts, glass, a nav bar, a mini player, whole player styles, pages, even a recreation of the app.

One switch turns a module on or off, and off means gone everywhere. Modules run in a sandbox: a look-only zip never touches the network, and a web module only hands back JSON and stream links.

  • Making one: start with Your first module, a whole module in two minutes.
  • Guide for module makers: modules/README.md.
  • Anything about safety: Security & sandbox.

FAQ

Q: Is it safe to log in? (read this before signing in)

A: You never have to log in to use this thing btw. Search, play, lyrics and downloads work without an account. Signing in is only for syncing your YouTube Music library, importing playlists from Spotify / Apple Music / Tidal, and Discord status.

How the sign-in works

  • Mochy opens the real login page of the service (for example accounts.google.com or open.spotify.com) inside the app. You type your password into their page, not into a Mochy form.
  • After you log in, the app keeps the session token or cookie that the service gives out, so you stay signed in. Your password is not what gets saved.
  • That session stays on your phone, in the app's private storage. Mochy has no account system of its own and does not run a server that collects logins.
  • The tokens are meant to be used only to talk to the service you signed in to (for example Spotify's own site to read your playlists).
  • The app is open source under GPL-3.0 so you do not have to take my word for it, you can always read exactly what it does with them 😃

Q: Pls add liquid glass

A: Not in the app itself, but it is possible as a module. See the Liquid Glass example.

Q: Monochrome/flac stream doesnt work

A: The server is down, it's on their side, not ours. Use other available sources, and join our discord.

Q: App too laggy, how to fix?

A: Turning blur off, or setting it to low, helps a lot.

Q: Animation is too slow, can you speed it up?

A: You can speed it up on the customise page.

Q: Can you add less spacing for the player?

A: You can customise it yourself.

Q: Official Desktop app?

A: Later.

Q: Can I contribute?

A: Ofc! See Contributing.

Q: I hate this app, I dont want to use it

A: Nobody is forcing you to use this.

How to build it yourself

You only need this if you want to change the code. If you just want to use the app, use the install steps above. The same guide with more detail is in the wiki.

What you need

  • A Mac, Linux or Windows computer with a screen
  • Android Studio (latest stable). It brings JDK 21 and the Android SDK with it
  • Android SDK 36 and NDK 27.0.12077973. Android Studio offers to download both the first time you open the project
  • About 10 GB free disk space, the first build downloads a lottt
  • A phone with USB debugging on, or an emulator

Steps

git clone https://github.com/realidkroo/mochy-music.git
cd mochy-music
  1. Open the folder in Android Studio once and let it finish syncing. This also creates local.properties with your SDK path.
  2. Build and install on your connected phone:
    ./build.sh --debug -i
    First build takes a while, the next ones are much faster.
  3. Or build the apk only and install it by hand. The apk lands in apk-generated/:
    ./build.sh --debug
adb install -r apk-generated/*-debug.apk

Handy options (see ./build.sh --help for all of them):

Command What it does
./build.sh --debug -i Debug build, installs and opens it on your phone
./build.sh --release -cc Release build for arm64 and universal
./build.sh -fd --release F-Droid flavor, without the self-update permission
./build.sh -n 4 --release -cc A nightly build (<version>.4)
./build.sh -k Stops stuck Gradle builds

Use debug while you are playing around, it builds much much faster. A debug build installs next to the real app, so it will not touch your normal install, but it is also a bit slower to run. Judge smoothness on a release build.

Optional keys

Mochy builds fine without these, only the matching feature is switched off. Put them in local.properties (it is never committed):

LASTFM_API_KEY=...
LASTFM_SECRET=...
DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=...

Never commit your keys. Libre.fm works without any key.

Check your change

./gradlew :app:compileArm64FossDebugKotlin   # does it compile?
./gradlew testDebugUnitTest                  # unit tests

If the build fails

  • Unresolved reference or Hilt errors that make no sense: delete the build/ folders and .gradle/ and build again.
  • Stuck or weird Gradle: ./build.sh -k, then try again.
  • Wrong Java: make sure Gradle uses JDK 21 (Android Studio → Settings → Build Tools → Gradle → Gradle JDK).
  • Still stuck? Open an issue with the error text.

Contributing

Want to send a fix? Read CONTRIBUTING first. The short version:

  1. Fork, make a short branch, keep one fix or feature per pull request.
  2. Match the code around you, and guard newer Android APIs with SDK_INT (Mochy supports Android 8+).
  3. Don't trade a feature or animation for speed. Show before/after screenshots for UI changes.
  4. Test it on a device, then open the pull request.

Note

AI written code is fine, blind AI slop is not. Read it, run it and understand it before you send it.

Found a bug? Report it on issues with your Mochy version, Android version, device, and what happened. Logs (adb logcat) and a screenshot help a lot.

Disclaimer

Mochy is an independent, unofficial project made for personal and educational use. It is provided as is, without warranty of any kind.

  • Mochy is a fully open source project that is created purely for educational and personal use. That's why we don't sell this software or monetize it. We do not have any intent to add commercial values in the future. Thanks!
  • We deeply respect the hard work of artists, musicians and content creators. Without them there is also no Mochy: I strongly suggest that you, as a user, subscribe to Apple Music or YouTube Premium, to support the creators you listen to. I do not intend to hurt creators with this app.
  • It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by YouTube, YouTube Music, Google, Spotify, Apple, Last.fm, Shazam, Discord or any other service it can connect to. All names, logos and brands belong to their respective owners.
  • Mochy does not host, store or distribute any music. Everything is fetched from third-party services when you ask for it, and those services can change or stop working at any time.
  • You are responsible for how you use the app, including the terms of service of the accounts and services you connect and the copyright laws where you live.
  • Importing from other services (Spotify, etc.) uses your own account. Don't share your login data or tokens with anyone.
  • Importing music MAY need your own account with its password. WE'RE NEVER see your password.

Forking Mochy

Forks are welcome, that's what open source is for! Just two asks:

  • Keep the credit. If you rename it, please keep credits of this app, the other project that helped mochy possible.
  • Keep it free. Mochy is not monetized and never will be. Please don't put features behind a paywall. A donation page is fine.

These incredible project helped mochy a lot! check them out too :3

  • ViviMusic by vivizzz007Z )Their repo) -- For the base app. This app is a fork from this project.
  • Metrolist by Mostafa Alagamy (Repository) -- For the base framework.
  • SimpMusic by maxrave-dev (Repository) -- For the lyrics API provider.
  • Archivetune by Rukamori (Repository) -- For design and architectural inspiration.

Open source APIs mochy talks to!!

Bitwarden mobile apps (Password Manager and Authenticator) for Android.

  • Target SDK: 37 (Android 17)

Setup

  1. Clone the repository:

    $ git clone https://github.com/bitwarden/android

  2. Create a user.properties file in the root directory of the project and add the following properties:

    • gitHubToken: A "classic" Github Personal Access Token (PAT) with the read:packages scope (ex: gitHubToken=gph_xx...xx). These can be generated by going to the Github tokens page. See the Github Packages user documentation concerning authentication for more details.
    • localSdk: A boolean value to determine if the SDK should be loaded from the local maven artifactory (ex: localSdk=true). This is particularly useful when developing new SDK capabilities. Review Linking SDK to clients for more details.

  3. Setup the code style formatter:

    All code must follow the guidelines described in the Code Style Guidelines document. To aid in adhering to these rules, all contributors should apply docs/bitwarden-style.xml as their code style scheme. In IntelliJ / Android Studio:

    • Navigate to Preferences > Editor > Code Style.
    • Hit the Manage button next to Scheme.
    • Select Import.
    • Find the bitwarden-style.xml file in the project's docs/ directory.
    • Import "from" BitwardenStyle "to" BitwardenStyle.
    • Hit Apply and OK to save the changes and exit Preferences.

    Note that in some cases you may need to restart Android Studio for the changes to take effect.

    All code should be formatted before submitting a pull request. This can be done manually but it can also be helpful to create a macro with a custom keyboard binding to auto-format when saving. In Android Studio on OS X:

    • Select Edit > Macros > Start Macro Recording
    • Select Code > Optimize Imports
    • Select Code > Reformat Code
    • Select File > Save All
    • Select Edit > Macros > Stop Macro Recording

    This can then be mapped to a set of keys by navigating to Android Studio > Preferences and editing the macro under Keymap (ex : shift + command + s).

    Please avoid mixing formatting and logical changes in the same commit/PR. When possible, fix any large formatting issues in a separate PR before opening one to make logical changes to the same code. This helps others focus on the meaningful code changes when reviewing the code.

  4. Setup JDK Version 21:

    • Navigate to Preferences > Build, Execution, Deployment > Build Tools > Gradle.
    • Hit the selected Gradle JDK next to Gradle JDK:.
    • Select a 21.x version or hit Download JDK... if not present.
    • Select Version 21.
    • Select your preferred Vendor.
    • Hit Download.
    • Hit Apply.

  5. Setup detekt pre-commit hook (optional):

Run the following script from the root of the repository to install the hook. This will overwrite any existing pre-commit hook if present.

echo "Writing detekt pre-commit hook..."
cat << 'EOL' > .git/hooks/pre-commit
#!/usr/bin/env bash

echo "Running detekt check..."
OUTPUT="/tmp/detekt-$(date +%s)"
./gradlew -Pprecommit=true detekt > $OUTPUT
EXIT_CODE=$?
if [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
  cat $OUTPUT
  rm $OUTPUT
  echo "***********************************************"
  echo "                 detekt failed                 "
  echo " Please fix the above issues before committing "
  echo "***********************************************"
  exit $EXIT_CODE
fi
rm $OUTPUT
EOL
echo "detekt pre-commit hook written to .git/hooks/pre-commit"
echo "Making the hook executable"
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit

echo "detekt pre-commit hook installed successfully to .git/hooks/pre-commit"

item.title: MuwMx/YumaPlayer
item.description:
🎵 Hybrid music client for Android: Spotify discovery & UI + YouTube Music library + Hi-Res Lossless (FLAC) streaming with fluid Glassmorphism💫

YumaPlayer (Yuma)

A hybrid music client for Android focused on usability, clean aesthetics, and audiophile-grade sound.
Spotify UI + Discovery Algorithms + YouTube Music Library + Hi-Res Lossless (FLAC) + Smart Automix.

Showcase • Features • Architecture • Download • Contributing • Support

🌟 About the Project

YumaPlayer is an independent, open-source Android music player that unites the libraries and recommendation features of two leading streaming services alongside standalone local playback in Hi-Res quality.

The project evolved as a comprehensive rebuild of ArchiveTune (with foundations from Metrolist and SimpMusic), inspired by PixelPlayer's queue mechanics, Meld's Spotify integration pipeline, and Stash's FLAC architecture. On top of this base, YumaPlayer implements a modular 20-module architecture, a dedicated low-level audio DSP engine, the custom YDS 2.1 design system, and hardware-accelerated fluid gesture physics.

No subscriptions. No advertisements. Zero telemetry, crash reporters, or third-party trackers. All credentials live exclusively on your device, encrypted with AES-256-GCM via Google Tink, and the codebase is completely open under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

📸 Showcase


Main Player (FLAC & Glass)
3-Tier Synced Lyrics
Queue

Immersive Artist Poster
Telegram-Style Morphing
Home (Quick Picks & YDS)

Spotify Feed & Recommendations
Spotify Radio & Mixes
Spotify Daily Mixes

🎬 Feature Walkthrough

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d363db0c-522b-4694-bd19-0dd9155ca240

✨ Key Features

🎛️ Audio Engine & Smart Automix

  • Dual-Deck Continuous Crossfade: True gapless and overlapping playback using two independent, synchronized audio deck controllers with atomic role swapping. Zero silence between tracks.
  • DJ Transition Intelligence: Automated outro/intro cue detection, energy cliff analysis, BPM matching, and complementary bass-swap filters (0.45–0.55 window).
  • Audiophile Codec Pipeline: Dedicated 24-bit packed PCM processing, Kopus-first Opus decoding with MediaCodec fallback, and native FLAC length resolution.
  • Smart Stall Recovery: Automatic degradation to hard cut on buffer underruns, automated stream revival upon network reconnection, and strict source-scoped cache identities.
  • N+1 Prefetching: Seamless background caching of upcoming tracks into the local download cache.

🔄 Dual Mode (Spotify + YouTube Music)

  • Spotify Catalog: In-app browsing of Spotify albums, Daily Mixes, Discover Weekly, and playlists with cross-script deduplication and locale-aware metadata.
  • YouTube Music Catalog: Full-catalog search across YouTube Music, charts, mood & genre categories, radio stations, and fast channel switching.
  • SponsorBlock Integration: Configurable in-app segment skipping for sponsor messages, music hooks, fillers, and subscription reminders.

🎧 Lossless Playback & Local Audio

  • Lossless FLAC: Stream and download true lossless FLAC tracks (via Qobuz / QBDLX backbone integration) using your own credentials or open community resolvers.
  • Seamless Fallback: If a track is unavailable in lossless catalogs, playback instantly routes through YouTube Music's high-bitrate stream (Opus / AAC).
  • Local Audio Engine: Built-in player for standalone files stored on your device (FLAC, MP3, AAC, OGG, WAV).
  • Audio Tuning: Built-in 5-band equalizer, EBU R128 loudness normalization, tempo and pitch adjustment, and a sleep timer.

🎨 Yuma Design System (YDS) & Fluid Motion

  • Draggable Navigation Island: Compact floating navigation dock inspired by Telegram specifications, featuring dynamic corner morphing, scroll-hide sync, and local haptic feedback.
  • Unified Player Sheet V2: Re-engineered gesture physics with GPU-accelerated backdrop blur (Haze), isolated drag layers, and independent artwork scaling.
  • Canvas Video Backdrops: Hardware-accelerated background video loops supporting up to 4K resolution with an isolated cache.
  • Spoiler Veil: Interactive Telegram-grade particle engine to obscure tokens and sensitive settings.
  • Dynamic Monet Theming: Adaptive palette extraction powered by the currently playing track's artwork, tuned for strict WCAG contrast compliance.

🎤 Synchronized Lyrics & AI Translation

  • 3-Tier Synchronized Display: Simultaneous live display of original lyrics (Kanji / Hangul), pronunciation guide (Romaji), and translated lines.
  • Live Karaoke Scrolling: Word-by-word and line-by-line sync pulled from 6+ providers (LRCLIB, Kugou, BetterLyrics, SimpMusic, Unison, YouLyPlus) with bounded memory allocation to prevent OOM.
  • On-the-Fly AI Translation: Instant translation of lyrics into your preferred language right inside the player.
  • Lyrics Card Sharing: Export and share formatted lyrics quote cards as clean images.

📥 Download & Installation

GitHub Releases Telegram Channel Canary Channel Obtainium

Building from Source

git clone https://github.com/MuwMx/YumaPlayer.git
cd YumaPlayer
./gradlew assembleRelease
# Built APK will be located at: app/build/outputs/apk/release/

Prerequisites: Android Studio with AGP 9.x support, JDK 21, Android SDK 37 (compileSdk/targetSdk 37, minSdk 26).

🏛️ Architecture & Tech Stack

YumaPlayer is organized as a 20-module Clean Architecture project following Unidirectional Data Flow (UDF):

  • UI & Presentation: Jetpack Compose, YDS 2.1 design tokens, GPU-accelerated Haze overlays, fluid gesture physics.
  • Audio Engine: Media3 (ExoPlayer), :core:audio-dsp (Smart Automix, dual-deck continuous crossfader, DJ filter cascade).
  • Network & Ingestion: :core:innertube (YouTube Music engine), Ktor/Retrofit, SOCKS5 proxy support with JVM Authenticator.
  • Storage & Security: Room ORM, hardware-backed secure preferences (AES-256-GCM via Google Tink).

📖 Detailed Developer Documentation:

  • Architecture Overview & Module Graph
  • Architectural Decision Records (ADRs)
  • Yuma Design System Specification (YDS 2.2)
  • Coding Standards & Rules

🌍 Globalization & Localization

YumaPlayer is localized into multiple languages thanks to our community translators. The localization pipeline is continuously synchronized with the codebase via Hosted Weblate.

Want to help translate Yuma? No coding or Git knowledge required. Just open our Weblate translation dashboard, choose your language, and start contributing directly through your browser.

⚙️ Account Setup

YumaPlayer is fully functional out of the box without signing in. Logging in is optional and only required to sync personal playlists, likes, and recommendations:

🎵 Connecting Spotify

  1. Open Settings → Account → Spotify → Tap Log In.
  2. Sign in with your standard Spotify credentials in the secure in-app browser window.
  3. Your session cookie (sp_dc) will be automatically captured and encrypted on your device.

📺 Connecting YouTube Music

Two login methods are supported:

  • Method 1 (Google Account): Open Settings → Account → YouTube → Sign in using the secure in-app authentication sheet.
  • Method 2 (Token / Cookie Input): If you use two-factor authentication or prefer manual setup, navigate to Settings → Account → Token Editor and paste your session cookies directly.

YumaPlayer is free, open source, and has no ads or subscriptions. If you enjoy using the player and wish to support ongoing development:

Contributions make open-source projects thrive! Whether you are fixing bugs, proposing new features, or improving docs:

  • Read our Contribution Guidelines before submitting code or PRs.
  • Want to translate? Head over to our Hosted Weblate — no coding required.

👥 Contributors

🤝 Acknowledgments (Open-Source Credits)

YumaPlayer is built on the shoulders of the open-source community:

Android GUI proxy utility (Empowered by sing-box)

Throne for Android

Android proxy client, powered by sing-box

Throne for Android manages proxy profiles and subscriptions, routes traffic with rule-based routing profiles, and works either as a VPN or as a proxy-only service. It shares Throne desktop's core and data model, so profiles, share links, route profiles and .thrbackup backups move freely between the two. See the documentation for guides.

Installation

APKs for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 are on GitHub Releases, with a SHA256SUMS file to verify them. Throne runs on Android 7.0 (API 24) or newer, including Android TV.

Upgrading from 1.x

Releases from v2.0.0 on are signed with a new key, so Android refuses to install them over a 1.x release (signature conflict). Uninstall the old release first, then import your subscriptions and profiles again: old local configurations are not migrated.

  • SOCKS
  • HTTP(S)
  • Shadowsocks

  • VMess
  • VLESS

Subscription Formats

Various formats are supported, including share links, various JSON representation of Sing-box configs, and v2rayN link format as well as limited support for Shadowsocks and Clash formats.

Deeplinks are also supported, read the documentation for more information.
